name: Generic
description: A starting point for any game: gameplay, content and UI, plus the animation, art and audio assets. Add the systems specific to your game below them.

pillars.name: Gameplay
pillars.description: The core loop, mechanics and rules the player interacts with.

pillars.name: Animation
pillars.description: How characters and objects move, and how that supports game feel.

pillars.name: Art
pillars.description: The visual style, assets and their budgets.

pillars.name: Audio
pillars.description: Music, sound effects and how they react to play.

pillars.name: Content
pillars.description: Levels, encounters, items and other authored content.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.description: Menus, HUD and how the game communicates with the player.
